sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the Petitioner and the State.
2. While allowing the prayer for modification, the Order No.02 dated 01.05.2023 passed in ABLAPL No.3210 of 2023 is hereby recalled and the following order is passed hereunder.

3. By means of this application, the Petitioner seeks grant of bail U/s.438 Cr.P.C. in apprehension of his custody for his alleged involvement in the offences U/s. 294/323/506/354/364(A)/34, I.P.C. in connection with I.C.C. Case No.59 of 2021 pending in the court of the learned J.M.F.C.,
Narasinghpur.

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that in the earlier order of this Court dated 01.05.2023 inadvertently the present Petitioner has been shown to be an accused in connection with the offences under Section 376(2)(n)/506, I.P.C. and Section 6 of the POCSO Act in connection with Narsinghpur P.S. Case No.124 of 2021 pending in the court of the learned J.M.F.C.,
Narsinghpur, whereas actually he is an accused in connection with I.C.C. Case No.59 of 2021 pending in that Court wherein the Court has been pleased to issue summon to the present Petitioner for his appearance on 12.12.2022.

Correcting, therefore, the said order, it is ordered that the present Petitioner who is an accused in connection with I.C.C. Case No.59 of 2021, allegedly to have committed the offences under Sections 294/323/506/354/364(A)/34, I.P.C. for having kidnapped Sushant Kumar Mishra @ Susali

Opposite Party on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189757636/
1 Jagannath Mishra @ Jagu, the son of the complainant Kalpana Mishra.
5.
Perusal of the record reveals that the complaint has been filed on 06.09.2021 whereas the incident of kidnapping took place on 18.08.2021.

Further, this complaint appears to be a counterblast to the F.I.R. lodged by one Indramani Sahu (father of the victim minor girl) in connection with Narsinghpur P.S. Case No.124 of 2021, wherein the son of the complainant namely Jagannath Mishra @ Jagu has been shown as prime accused who allegedly to have committed rape on the minor daughter of the informant Indramani Sahu.

6. Keeping in view the above facts and submissions, nature of the allegation, seriousness and gravity of the offence, while this Court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail, it is directed that in the event the Petitioner surrenders and moves for bail before the learned J.M.F.C., Narsinghpur in connection with I.C.C. Case No.59 of 2021 within three weeks from today, the learned court above shall pass appropriate order considering the indulgence of the Petitioner in the crime which emanates from a complaint much after the lodging of the FIR against the son of the complainant in connection with the rape committed by him and further that the complaint was filed about one month after the alleged kidnapping.
In view of the above, the I.A. is disposed of.

(Chittaranjan Dash) Judge S.K. Parida Designation: Asst. Registrar-cum-Sr.Secretary Sushant Kumar Mishra @ Susali vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189757636/
